label: Copy-phase update gate: fixed (L, recall position) timing slots plus inputs h/i
explanation: Active only in the copy phase (t > L), never during the original tokens or on <DEL>; almost never at recall_idx 1 except when L=3. Two unrelated components. (1) Timing slots that depend on length: L=3 at recall 1 and 2 (92-99% active, and the strongest activations of the unit, up to max), L=4 at recall 2 (~52%), L=9 at recall 3 (~45%). (2) Token identity: copy-phase steps (recall>=2) whose input token is h or i (~68% active); n, r and u fire more weakly. What is left is diffuse, low-rate firing at later recall positions for L=6-9 (10-23% per slot, peaking near to_go=1) that no simple variable captures. Dev F1 0.59, mass recall 0.73. Adding n/r/u raises mass recall to 0.83 but drops precision to 0.44.
